name: Fishing has a place in progression

pages.text: Fishing provides food and useful discoveries. As your fishing setup improves, check unfamiliar catches and equipment in JEI rather than treating everything as dinner.$(br2)Neptunium can eventually support your Tinkers workshop. Its prepared tool material belongs to HV manufacturing, so a good catch can become a resource for a later project.
Before a long trip: carry food you can replace, a spare supply and the equipment needed to gather more if the expedition runs long.
